dispositions.topic_text: Required test for preserving the replaced file's placement, stored image, and mark when replacement content is already placed
dispositions.what: Cover replacement by content that already has a placement in the INV-07 check, or leave it to the INV-06 replay check; check that the earlier placement, stored image and mark keep their bytes; either way INV-07 holds: replacing or removing a source file changes no earlier placement, stored image or mark.
